ai.description: *Micrixalus elegans* is a small frog (25–30 mm) with a brown dorsum and cream-colored belly. It is distinguished by a prominent white throat patch and long, slender limbs adapted for torrent life.
ai.identificationRemarks: The most reliable diagnostic cue for *Micrixalus elegans* is the presence of a distinct, bright white or pale yellow patch on the throat, which is absent in similar species.
ai.habitat: *Micrixalus elegans* inhabits rocky streams within evergreen forests of the Western Ghats, typically at elevations between 500 and 1,200 meters.
ai.behavior: The Elegant Torrent Frog is primarily diurnal, often seen perched on mossy rocks near fast-flowing streams where it actively hunts small insects during the day.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Micrixalus elegans* is an egg-laying species that breeds during the monsoon, depositing small clutches of eggs in hidden nests beneath stream-bed gravel.
ai.distributionRemarks: *Micrixalus elegans* is endemic to the Western Ghats of India, primarily occurring in the states of Kerala and Karnataka at elevations between 300 and 1,200 meters.
ai.callDescription: The Elegant Torrent Frog produces a high-pitched, rhythmic "tink-tink" call, typically heard amidst the rushing water of its fast-flowing rocky stream habitat.
